_doc: TANG 2 — phan nganh giay chay cua loi dan nhin anh: mo ta hang hoa de mo hinh doc dung.
huongDan: Hang hoa cua nganh: giay chay bo / giay the thao (adidas, Nike, ASICS, HOKA, Saucony, New Balance, Puma...), quan ao va phu kien the thao. Ma tren tem thuong 2 CHU IN HOA + 4 SO (JP9252, IG8054) hoac dang JI8190-100.
Anh chup tem trong luoi giay / hop (co size, ma article) van la san_pham; ghi code va them size doc duoc vao text.

Doi giay = so sau ten dong (Pegasus 41, Boston 13, Gel-Kayano 31, Clifton 10). Chi ghi so doi khi THAY so do in tren giay / tem / hop / anh chup man hinh; khong thay thi model chi ghi ten dong (vd "Nike Pegasus"). tuKhoa vi du: pegasus, boston, kayano, clifton, duramo. Chu cong nghe in tren de / than (AIR ZOOM, REACTX, ZOOMX, LIGHTSTRIKE, BOOST, GEL, FLYTEFOAM) KHONG phai ten dong.
